Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-expansion-subsystem-id
Property.Description: This property describes a subsystem ID to be used to determine the correct function expansion driver to be installed/loaded. This value is vendor-specific.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-expansion-subsystem-revision-id
Property.Description: This optional property provides a subsystem revision ID to be used to determine the correct function expansion driver to be installed/loaded. This value is vendor-specific.

Property.Name: mid-*
Property.Description: Vendor may add any vendor specific properties to this descriptor. This is the only descriptor in SDCA where Vendor can specify implementation defined properties. Note that the vendor prefix represented by mid is the vendor's MIPI Manufacturer ID, a four-digit hexadecimal number. E.g. 0339-sample-property for a Dell-defined property.
